detailed_description: The Color Converter keeps HEX, RGB, and HSL color values in sync. You can pick a color, edit the HEX value, or adjust RGB channels, and the page updates the related values for quick copying. It is designed for everyday design and frontend work where a color needs to move between CSS formats. The tool currently focuses on standard 6-digit HEX, RGB channel values, and HSL output. It does not attempt color-profile conversion, accessibility scoring, or palette generation.
usage_steps: Use the color picker or enter a 6-digit HEX value.
Edit the RGB channel fields if you prefer numeric input.
Review the updated HEX, RGB, and HSL values.
Click Copy beside the format you need.
Paste the value into CSS, design notes, or a style token file.
Check contrast separately if the color will be used for text.
usage_examples: Convert #3b82f6 into RGB and HSL values for CSS.
Adjust the red, green, and blue fields to explore nearby colors.
Copy an HSL value for a Tailwind or design-token note.
Use the preview swatch to confirm the color before copying.

faqs.question: Which color formats does this tool convert?
faqs.answer: It converts between 6-digit HEX, RGB, and HSL values.

faqs.question: Can I copy the converted values?
faqs.answer: Yes. HEX, RGB, and HSL each have a copy action.

faqs.question: Does it support alpha transparency?
faqs.answer: The current converter focuses on opaque HEX, RGB, and HSL values, not alpha channels.

faqs.question: Does the tool check color contrast?
faqs.answer: No. Use a dedicated contrast checker when you need accessibility validation.

faqs.question: Why did my invalid HEX value not update the other formats?
faqs.answer: The converter expects a complete 6-digit HEX value. Invalid or partial input may not produce RGB and HSL updates.
